decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits ownership and mint reporting to NFTs from the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that active-system metadata uses only replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy-contract metadata.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts dashboard NFT rendering to the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits owner NFT discovery to replacement-contract NFTs and marks legacy-contract NFTs as undiscoverable.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits book-access eligibility to NFTs from the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that subsequent USDC mints use the active replacement contract only.
This Requirement is directly introduced by the accepted migration decision and already records the fresh-state and legacy-NFT exclusion policy.
The contract migration and fresh statistics state do not require any change to the landing page's static copy or layout requirements.
The migration decision does not necessarily change the approved About-page topics or prize-mechanics copy.
The decision to use a fresh replacement contract does not explicitly require revising the approved FAQ content.
The source excludes old NFTs from active systems, but it does not safely establish whether historical referral and payout totals must also be discarded or retained as financial history.
Changing to a fresh replacement contract does not alter the current mint price, affiliate commission, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
